integrity: Finite exact checks support but do not establish infinite asymptotic statements; all proofs and limitations are supplied and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to uniform-priority nearest-neighbor monomer blocking on a wheel; path CLT and variance coefficient are known; historical priority of the wheel mixture boundary is not independently certified; no independent audit.
title: Rare-hub variance inflation and nonuniform Gaussian fluctuations in greedy wheel adsorption
